analyst_view.overall: Como arrive in outstanding form after a 9-1 Champions League win at Lens, while Inter lost the Milan derby before beating Feyenoord in midweek and want a win before the international break. Lautaro Martínez and Luis Henrique are out for Inter, with Thuram and Pio Esposito expected up front and Bastoni back. Cesc Fabregas is without Kean, Diao, Addai, Jesús Rodríguez and Chalobah but otherwise picks his strongest side.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.0 goals. Como have been scoring heavily and Fabregas says they will play their own game at San Siro rather than sit deep, while Inter need a response after the derby. Lautaro's absence takes something off Inter, but an open game seems more likely than a tight one.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.4 corners. Inter's wing-backs Dimarco and Spence push on, but Como keep the ball better than most visitors, which can cut Inter's corner count, so we stay with the site.

cards.text: The numbers say 3.0 cards. Both teams want to play football and nothing in the news points to a bad-tempered match, so we keep the low figure.

shots.text: The numbers say 27.7 shots. Como's attack (Douvikas, Nico Paz, Da Cunha) is in red-hot form and Inter will push hard at home, so plenty of shooting at both ends looks likely.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.6 shots on target. Como are creating and finishing chances at a rare rate and Thuram and Esposito should test Butez, so we lean slightly above the site.
